title: Samba releases security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-270.012120: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY- SAMBA RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: The Samba Team has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple versions of Samba.
contentHtml:
The Samba Team has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple versions of Samba.

An attacker could exploit one of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

The Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (TTCSIRT) encourages users and administrators to review the Samba Security Announcements for CVE-2019-14902, CVE-2019-14907, and CVE-2019-19344 and apply the necessary updates and workarounds.

For further review please see the following links:

https://www.samba.org/samba/security/CVE-2019-14902.html 

https://www.samba.org/samba/security/CVE-2019-14907.html

https://www.samba.org/samba/security/CVE-2019-19344.html
